subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 8: Skills – Listening, speaking and writing an email
outcomes: Listen for information about shops in a town.
Use the apostrophe in shop names like greengrocer's.
Write an email to a friend suggesting shops to visit.

tf.s: The shopping mall in Westport is called the Smith Centre.
Nada likes to buy apples and pears from the greengrocer's.
tf.why: She buys apples and pears there.

tf.s: Nada's favourite shop is the pharmacy.
tf.why: Her favourite shop is the toy shop, Kids Toys.

tf.s: In Westport, there is a pharmacy in the shopping mall.
tf.why: You can go there for medicine.
Kiosk doesn't need 's. Fishmonger does: fishmonger's.

tf.s: We can end an email to a friend with "Love from …".
tf.why: Love from … is a friendly ending.

tf.s: In Westport, you can go to the jeweller's for medicine.
tf.why: You can go to the pharmacy in the shopping mall.

tf.s: We start an email to a friend with "Hi …,".
tf.why: Hi Basma, is a friendly start.

tf.s: Meat is the odd one out in: apples, bananas, meat, carrots.
tf.why: Meat is from the butcher's; the others are from the greengrocer's.

boxes.q: What is the shopping mall in Westport called?
Where can you go for medicine in Westport?
boxes.why: The pharmacy is in the shopping mall.
Her favourite shop is Kids Toys.

boxes.q: How do you start an email to your friend Basma?
How does Sharifa end her email?
Complete: This is the new shop ______ you can buy nice presents.
Complete: Some children get ______ money from their mum or dad.
What is the name of a machine which carries you upstairs and downstairs?
boxes.why: An escalator goes up and down.

hunt.q: Odd one out: apples, meat, carrots

mcq.q: Why do we write an apostrophe in "greengrocer's"?
o: It is short for the greengrocer's shop.
It is a name of a person only.

mcq.q: Which is a friendly start for an email?
What kind of market is in Westport?
o: a fish market on a boat

mcq.q: Which phrase can start the first line of an email asking for advice?
o: You asked for some advice about …
mcq.why: This phrase answers your friend's question.

mcq.q: Write one sentence suggesting a shop.
o: In the toy shop, you can buy amazing kites.
In the toy shop, you can buys amazing kites.
You can buying kites in the toy shop.

mcq.q: You have 15 OMR. You buy a book for 6 OMR. How much do you save?

o: At the market, there's a great fishmonger's.
At the market, there's a great fishmongers'.
At the market, there's a great fish'monger.
At the market, there a great fishmonger's.

mcq.q: Which plan note is best for an email about shops?
o: toy shop – in the mall – big kites
mcq.why: Good notes say the shop, where it is and what is special.

mcq.q: Which group of names all need 's?
mcq.why: These names are short for … shop.

mcq.q: Which email is in the correct order?
o: Hi Ali, … You asked for some advice … At the market, … Love from Saif.
Hi Ali, Love from Saif. You asked …
mcq.why: Greeting, then the message, then the ending.
